newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Comfort, Lum Chang units win land tender.
newsitem.headline: Comfort, Lum Chang units win land tender.

text.p: Comfort Group Ltd said on Tuesday it had won a Singapore $139 million government land tender as part of a consortium to develop condominiums in the western part of Singapore.
The consortium comprises Waterbank Properties (S) Pte Ltd, Comfort Properties Pte Ltd, L.C. Development Ltd and Lum Chang Building Contractors Pte Ltd, Comfort Group said in a statement.
It said the 21,000 sq metre land parcel had a 99-year leasehold tenure.

Comfort Group said its wholly-owned subsidiary Comfort Properties had entered an agreement with the other consortium members to form a joint venture company for the purchase, construction and development of the condominiums.

Comfort Properties and Waterbank Properties will each have a 30 percent stake in the joint venture company, Boon Lay Executive Condominiums Pte Ltd, with the other parters each taking 20 percent stakes.
Comfort said it intended to finance its initial S$300,000 investment in the joint venture company from internal resources.
